item.title: Origin acquires interest in Newcastle’s Allegro Energy and agrees to long duration storage trial at Eraring — Andiron Group
item.description: Origin Energy has acquired a 5% stake in Allegro and has agreed to a pilot of their long duration Redox Flow battery at Eraring Power Station.

item.title: Inter IKEA acquires a 12.5% stake in plastics deep tech NILO — Andiron Group
item.description: Such is the potential for NILO’s product and process, IKEA has acquired a 12.5% stake and has entered into a development and access agreement that will see subsidiary, Inter IKEA, able to use Nilo’s patented plastic waste-derived adhesive in the production of its wood-based products.
